newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Philippines to sell 20 pct stake in steel firm.
newsitem.headline: Philippines to sell 20 pct stake in steel firm.

text.p: The Philippines' Committee on Privatisation has approved the sale of the 20 percent government stake in the National Steel Corp through public bidding, a government official said on Tuesday.
State-owned National Development Co (NDC) is set to sell 448 million shares of the country's largest steel company to institutional investors through four sets of public biddings.
"We're hoping to conduct the biddings by the first week of October," NDC assistant general manager Ditas Rebueno told reporters.
The indicative price of the shares has been pegged at 10 pesos per share.
The NDC currently holds 25 percent stake in National Steel. The remaining five percent would be sold to small investors through an initial public offering.
In an earlier round, the privatisation panel had approved the sale of 75 percent of National Steel's equity to Malaysia's Wing Tiek Holdings Bhd.
The deal is yet to be finalised with the NDC saying some payments are still due from the Malaysian firm.
National Steel accounts for over 40 percent of the local steel output with an annual production capacity of 3.5 million tonnes. - Manila newsroom 63 2 8418938 Fax 8176267
